_comment: Machine-readable learning-behavior contract. Each invariant has an ID, a severity, and the test-name substrings that must have at least one passing test. learn-check fails if an active invariant has no passing test, or if a listed test name matches nothing. Changing behavior means editing this file AND its tests AND the implementation together (the 'revise door' — see CONTRACT.md).

invariants.statement: A grade turn must not render unless an agreeing grade-audit receipt is present; a missing receipt is withheld with NO_GRADE_AUDIT_PASS. One batched `items[]` envelope may carry several learner answers, and a mismatch surfaces the per-item corrections. Only the newest grade verdict may block: a stale `agrees:false` receipt is superseded by a corrected agreeing re-dispatch, so it cannot poison every later grade turn.
tests: normal grade turn allowed
grade turn with no receipt withheld
batched items[] grade envelope binds a multi-answer grade turn
batched grade mismatch surfaces per-item corrections
corrected batched re-dispatch clears the mismatch
newest grade verdict supersedes an older disagreement

invariants.statement: A verifier receipt is consumed by the message it verifies, so the same receipt cannot authorize a second grading turn (verify A, emit B is blocked).
tests: second grade turn blocked once receipt consumed

invariants.statement: A generation that did not finish (stopReason error/aborted/length) passes through ungated with its turn tag stripped, and does not consume a verifier receipt.
tests: errored partial is not withheld
re-emitted grade turn allowed after errored partial

invariants.statement: An ingest summary does not render without a valid review verdict (NO_REVIEW_GATE_PASS), and an ingest summary is not held hostage after the Clerk returns.
tests: ingest summary renders
tagged ingest follow-up not held hostage

invariants.statement: A review verdict relayed by the Clerk instead of an independent review-gate run is surfaced with an INGEST GATE banner (never silently trusted).
tests: clerk-relayed verdict triggers INGEST GATE banner

invariants.statement: A review-family verdict with no evidence list is treated as unsubstantiated and surfaced with a banner.
tests: missing-evidence banner surfaced

invariants.statement: A partial or missing Scout digest surfaces a banner but never withholds the teaching turn.
tests: scout-unverified banner surfaced
sources-incomplete banner surfaced

invariants.statement: After two consecutive provider failures for a verifier/scout, the withheld banner offers a one-shot alternate-model fallback directive (never forces it).
tests: fallback directive after two provider failures

invariants.statement: Re-dispatching a fact-check for a draft that already has a valid receipt is blocked, while a materially corrected draft after an ISSUES verdict is allowed.
tests: duplicate fact-check of a verified draft is blocked
corrected re-dispatch after ISSUES is allowed

invariants.statement: Async subagent completion notifications mint content-bound receipts from the dispatch envelope, and a failed async run clears its pending state without minting.
tests: async fact-check binds its tagged claims turn
claims emit after the completion notification renders
failed verifier is not reported as in-flight

invariants.statement: A dropped claims tag is recovered only from a content-bound passing fact-check receipt (≥85% coverage); unbound messages still withhold.
tests: dropped claims tag recovered from bound fact-check

invariants.statement: A dropped grade/quiz tag is inferred from a bound verifier receipt, or the single valid pending receipt; ambiguous or absent receipts withhold.
tests: items[] grade envelope binds a dropped-tag grade turn

invariants.statement: A claims turn does not render without a content-matched, passing fact-check; a pending async fact-check withholds with a wait hint instead of dead-ending.
tests: unverified untagged message still withheld
claims emit before notification is withheld with a wait hint

invariants.statement: The generator may not curate its own exam: every hard fact in a fact-check draft (decimal, percentage, scientific notation, 3+ digit integer, LaTeX/math expression, URL) must appear in the submitted claims[], or the turn is withheld as CLAIMS_INCOMPLETE so a number or formula nobody listed cannot pass unverified.
tests: draft with an unlisted hard fact is withheld
hard fact listed in claims is allowed

invariants.statement: An emission may reproduce a verified draft with reordering or punctuation edits but may not append unverified prose: at most 12 emitted tokens may be absent from the draft (previously a 1.4x length ratio allowed an unbounded unverified tail).
tests: unverified tail beyond the draft is withheld

invariants.statement: Teaching content tagged [[TURN:none]] while its fact-check is still in flight or already verified is withheld (FACT_CHECK_PENDING / TURN_TAG_MISMATCH). Review-flow carve-out: closing review feedback/summaries legitimately reuse verified prose, so a none turn covered by a passing fact-check renders in the review flow.
tests: none-tagged teaching draft withheld while fact-check in flight
none tag over a verified draft is withheld
review-flow none summary over a verified draft renders
none over a verified draft still withholds outside review

invariants.statement: A session that never starts a learning flow (no [[FLOW:...]] marker) is never gated; messages pass through untouched.
tests: non-learning session is never gated

invariants.statement: After a Learning System write in teach/resume, a summary turn requires a passing tutor-audit over the files written; a quiz/grade turn is not held hostage.
tests: tutor-audit required after a learning-system write
tutor-audit pass releases the handoff summary

invariants.statement: After the review flow's writes land — the delegated review-clerk run, or a session-note write — a summary turn requires a review-session audit receipt.
tests: review-session audit required after session-note write
review-session pass releases the close summary
review-clerk writes require a review-session audit
review-clerk close released by review-session pass

invariants.statement: A review's first claims/quiz turn is withheld with NO_REVIEW_CONTEXT until a review-scout run has happened; a partial review digest surfaces a banner (REVIEW CONTEXT INCOMPLETE), never a withhold.
tests: review without a context scout run is withheld
review context incomplete banner surfaced
review context scout releases the first review turn

invariants.statement: A new lesson's teaching claims are withheld with NO_SCOUT_CONTEXT until a scout run has happened.
tests: new lesson without a scout run is withheld

invariants.statement: Repeated withheld turns are capped; after the cap the turn surfaces with ⛔ UNVERIFIED rather than looping forever.
tests: repeated withheld turns are blocked before the cap
retry cap surfaces unverified after 2 withholdings

invariants.statement: Review findings that are all out-of-scope state/bookkeeping are demoted to flags so a clean target page is not re-reviewed forever.
tests: out-of-scope review issues render as flags, not withheld

invariants.statement: The dispatch envelope is recovered from tool_call when pi-subagents compacts a foreground result (task redacted), so receipts still bind.
tests: redacted foreground task binds a tagged claims turn
redacted foreground task binds a dropped-tag claims turn

invariants.statement: A receipt minted from a present-but-wrong-shape dispatch envelope must not satisfy its gate: a quiz/grade receipt with no bound text (quiz: no questions_json/questions; grade: no question+learner_answer+claimed_verdict) authorizes no emission, and a write-gate receipt with no artifact list (tutor-audit files, review-session written_files, review-gate target_files) releases no summary. Only an envelope-less async completion notification falls back to unbound.
tests: wrong-shape quiz receipt does not bind an unrelated quiz turn
questions_json quiz receipt binds its own batch
envelope-less async quiz receipt still binds its turn
tutor-audit without files does not release the handoff summary
review-session audit without written_files does not release the close summary
review-gate without target_files does not release the ingest summary

invariants.statement: A quiz-audit receipt binds the whole emitted batch: the envelope's `rendered_content` (the full batch text) is the bound text the judge sees, and without it the derived bound text includes each item's `options`, so a questions-only binding cannot strand a valid turn as QUIZ_AUDIT_STALE.
tests: rendered_content quiz receipt binds the full batch
quiz turn with full rendered_content binds
judge package carries the full quiz batch as boundText
derived quiz boundText includes the options

invariants.statement: A [[TURN:viz]] message renders only with a passing, bound viz-audit receipt: a missing receipt is withheld NO_VIZ_AUDIT, an ISSUES verdict withholds VIZ_AUDIT_ISSUES, and a valid-but-unbound receipt withholds VIZ_AUDIT_STALE.
tests: viz turn renders with a bound viz-audit
viz turn without a viz-audit is withheld
viz-audit ISSUES withholds the viz turn

invariants.statement: A viz-audit receipt binds only when its canonical `spec` equals the emitted fenced spec AND its `rendered_content` covers the emitted text; a different spec, or a present-but-wrong-shape envelope missing the spec or rendered_content, authorizes no emission.
tests: viz-audit with a different spec does not bind
wrong-shape viz receipt does not bind a viz turn

invariants.statement: A ```viz fence may only appear in a [[TURN:viz]] message; a viz block inside a claims or transition turn is withheld (VIZ_REQUIRES_OWN_TURN), so a figure is always gated as its own turn.
tests: viz block in a claims turn is withheld
viz block in a none turn is withheld

invariants.statement: A [[TURN:viz]] message with no parseable ```viz JSON spec block is withheld VIZ_SPEC_INVALID.
tests: unparseable viz spec is withheld

invariants.statement: A dropped viz tag is recovered from a bound viz-audit receipt (canonical spec match + prose coverage).
tests: dropped viz tag recovered from a bound viz-audit

invariants.statement: When a judge is configured, a turn tag is a hint: the judge reads the turn type from the content, so an untagged claims turn whose fact-check covers it renders instead of withholding NO_TURN_TAG. Verifier/notification channels are never gated.
tests: untagged claims turn allowed via judge classification

invariants.statement: When a judge is configured, a turn renders only when 100% of the emitted text is covered by the verifier's verified draft; any uncovered span blocks and the remedy names the span.
tests: uncovered span blocks
remedy names the uncovered span

invariants.statement: A verifier PASS that the judge scores as unsubstantiated (thin or none, missing items, no evidence) does not verify the turn. Verifiers whose clean verdict is an empty `issues:[]` (quiz-audit, tutor-audit, viz-audit, review-gate, review-session-audit) must emit a mandatory non-empty `evidence` list, or every clean PASS dead-ends as `*_STALE` (the 2026-10-05 session looped on the empty quiz PASS).
tests: hollow PASS blocked as unsubstantiated

invariants.statement: While a high or medium verifier issue remains, the gate keeps blocking and never dumps the turn as UNVERIFIED; the retry cap applies only to every other block reason.
tests: high/medium issue never dumps as UNVERIFIED

invariants.statement: When the same issue blocks the same turn three times, the judge is asked whether the issue still applies; if it does not, the engine releases the turn with a VERIFIER DISPUTED banner. The judge only answers; the engine acts.
tests: dispute releases the turn with VERIFIER DISPUTED

invariants.statement: A receipt is the verifier's own statement: the judge receives the verifier's parsed receipt and verified draft, and never authors or rewrites receipt fields.
tests: judge package carries the verified draft

invariants.statement: When the judge is unavailable, rate-limited, or returns invalid output, the gate falls back to the legacy deterministic checks for that turn; a learning turn never dead-ends on a judge fault.
tests: judge failure falls back to legacy checks

invariants.statement: A hard case (a valid receipt that does not fully cover, no best receipt with receipts present, or thin substantiveness) escalates from the primary judge (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) to the escalation model (gemini-3.5-flash). Escalation is budget-capped per day, and a primary outage escalates before falling back to the legacy path.
tests: hard case escalates to the secondary judge
escalation is capped per day
primary outage falls through to the escalation judge

invariants.statement: Verifier/worker dispatches go through the `dispatch` helper, which accepts the JSON envelope as an OBJECT (never a JSON-encoded string) and runs the child through pi-subagents' structured delegation bridge. `dispatch` mints the gate receipt itself, so a model that emits an object `task` (the shape that dead-ends the `subagent` tool) still gets a bound receipt; the legacy `subagent` workflow/args forms are blocked and redirected to `dispatch`.
tests: dispatch helper is registered
dispatch accepts an object task and returns the child output
dispatch-minted quiz receipt binds the emitted batch
malformed subagent workflow is blocked toward dispatch

invariants.statement: A grade turn that also teaches (the diagnose-first repair) is covered by two receipts: the `grade-audit` covers the graded question/answer/verdict and the `fact-check` covers the repair prose (`rendered_content` = the full emitted turn). When the grade-audit does not cover the whole emitted text and no fact-check covers it, the turn is withheld (GRADE_AUDIT_STALE) with a remedy to fact-check the prose or split the turn — the gate never loops re-dispatching the grade-audit.
tests: grade+repair turn allowed when grade-audit and fact-check both cover it
grade+repair without a fact-check is GRADE_AUDIT_STALE

invariants.statement: A verdict-only grade turn (`[[TURN:grade]]` presenting only the graded answers and their verdicts, e.g. "Correct on all three: W1 B, W2 C, W3 A") renders with just the agreeing `grade-audit` receipt. The grade-audit binds the graded question/answer/verdict, which a terse confirmation does not repeat verbatim, so both the model judge (a GRADE TURNS carve-out to the 100% rule) and the deterministic fallback (every graded answer restated, turn no longer than half the graded question text) accept it. A teaching/repair tail is still not covered by the grade receipt and needs its own fact-check — the 2026-10-06 resume session looped as GRADE_AUDIT_STALE because a verdict-only turn could not bind at all.
tests: verdict-only grade turn binds a full-sentence grade envelope
verdict-only grade turn binds despite uncovered judge verdict
verdict-only envelope does not cover a repair tail
